first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: green soccer field
entities.identification: The green grass playing field that is the main subject of the image, with the penalty area, goal area, penalty arc, and end line visible.

entities.name: sideline advertising barrier
entities.identification: Long advertising boards with various background colors and text, arranged along the outer edge of the grass.

entities.name: group of players in green clothing
entities.identification: Three players on the field wearing green tops, green shorts, and white knee-high socks, excluding Person D.

entities.name: group of players in dark clothing
entities.identification: Three players on the field wearing blue-and-black tops and dark-colored bottoms, one of whom, on the near side, advances with the ball.

entities.name: Person D
entities.identification: The goalkeeper in front of Object D, wearing a bright orange jersey, shorts, and knee-high socks.

entities.name: soccer ball
entities.identification: The small white sphere by the feet of the near-side player with the ball, moving away from the feet toward the top of the image in the final segment.

entities.name: Object D
entities.identification: The goal in the upper left of the image, consisting of white goalposts, a crossbar, and a light-colored net, and defended by Person D.

entities.name: gray tiered stands
entities.identification: The gray tiered stands in the upper left and upper portion of the image, with horizontal rows of seats, stepped aisles, and railings.

entities.name: group of spectators in the stands
entities.identification: Background spectators mainly distributed among the seats toward the right along the top edge of the image.

entities.name: off-field group of people in vests
entities.identification: A group of people in the off-field passageway and along the far edge, with bright yellow vests, orange upper-body clothing, and dark-colored bottoms visible.

entities.name: off-field gray rigid passageway
entities.identification: The gray area between the sideline advertising barrier and the lower edge of the stands.

entities.name: white advertising surface beyond the end line
entities.identification: Rectangular advertising surfaces with white backgrounds, large black text, and red graphics, beyond the end line on both sides of Object D.
